content.goal_pattern: Reduce precision dependence in constant-curvature geodesic convex optimization.
content.key_choice: Work on radius R=1/sqrt(K) neighborhoods; solve local subproblems to a prescribed fraction of epsilon M R.
content.key_relation: The pullback need not be convex; subgradient halfspaces still contain all better points, and local metric distortion controls the accuracy-to-volume argument.
proof_skeleton: Repeat local approximate minimization to reduce global gap.
Pull the local problem into Klein coordinates and initialize a Euclidean enclosing ball.
Use objective or feasibility separating cuts; shrink ellipsoid volume.
content.required_inputs: Local geodesic map preserving geodesics/halfspaces, metric distortion bound, implementable cuts and Euclidean ellipsoid updates.
